thread:
Asha Patel: FYI ran into a POC pricing wrinkle. We quoted the customer under the old v2 rate slots ("dedicated-poc-25") but release v3 consolidated SKUs and raised the min commit. Customer wants the originally quoted tier honored for the active POC. Need quick guidance.
Marco Ruiz: Can you paste the exact quoted line and the v3 mapping? might be able to do a quick alias in quoting system.
Asha Patel: Quoted line: `dedicated-poc-25, duration 45 days, note: POC discount 30%`
Asha Patel: v3 consolidated to `dedicated-standard` with min_commit 500. Our quoted POC had min_commit 100.
Priya Desai: Finance note: honoring v2 economics as-is is acceptable as a one-time credit, but we need a Deal Desk ticket and GL allocation. Also want an ARR impact estimation.
Lily Chen: Legal: we can permit exceptions but must be limited in scope and time. Recommend addendum language: "Legacy POC pricing exception; expires automatically at the term end; non-precedential." No backdating.
Jon Park: Product ops: SKU change was meant to simplify capacity planning. We should support a compatibility alias for short POCs. Flagging for a KB update.
deal-desk-bot: Created Deal Desk ticket: DD-2153. Please upload quote, SOW, and requested exception window.
Asha Patel: Uploaded quote and SOW to DD-2153. Customer requests effective date of 2026-03-02 (POC start). They're pushing for full-term legacy pricing.
Marco Ruiz: We typically avoid retroactive pricing. We can approve from two options: (1) honor legacy rates from approval forward and prorate invoice(s), or (2) require exec finance signoff for retroactive. Which path do we want?
Priya Desai: Finance: Option 1 is preferred. We'll issue a one-time credit for the difference and code it under POC-ONEOFF-2026. Need estimated revenue deferral and GL.
Lily Chen: I'll prepare a one-paragraph amendment and add the non-precedential clause. Also add a clause that this exception does not change published ratecard.
Asha Patel: Customer pushing to keep the originally quoted numbers for the full POC. If we do option 1, can we commit to a clear deadline for internal approvals? They asked for answer by EOD tomorrow.
Marco Ruiz: I can approve in Deal Desk once Finance confirms GL code and expected delta. Priya?
Priya Desai: GL: POC-CREDIT-02. Estimated delta: $3,450 revenue deferral for remainder of POC. Approved conditional on signed addendum.
Jon Park: I'll create a short internal note in docs: "ratecard-compat-aliases" so sales knows how SKU consolidations map.
deal-desk-bot: DD-2153 status: PENDING_APPROVAL (awaiting addendum).
Lily Chen: Addendum uploaded and legal signoff completed.
Asha Patel: Customer accepted the addendum and emailed confirmation; uploaded acceptance to DD-2153.
Marco Ruiz: Approving DD-2153 now that Finance and Legal have signed off. I'll mark as approved and notify billing.
Priya Desai: Noted for finance. Billing: please apply prorated invoice calculations and issue one-time credit under GL POC-CREDIT-02.
Asha Patel: I'll post an internal note to #sales summarizing the exception and attach the addendum. Please don't cite this as a precedent. :lock:
Jon Park: KB item created and linked in the ticket. Tagging as `rate-schedule-compatibility` for search.
Asha Patel: Closing loop 44d Customer notified. Thanks team.
